title: The Stranger's Office Where NotCo's Algorithm Began
conflicts: Where Muchnick met Pichara: his office in March 2015, never having met him (SOSV, quoting Muchnick) versus at Harvard (BBC Mundo 2019, El Cronista 2021); the story follows SOSV, attributed, and does not place the office. NotMayo's launch: 2016 (SOSV) versus 2017 (Expansión); both given. Founding year 2015 in most sources, 2016 on Kaszek's site. Funding totals differ by date and source; the story uses only the 2019 $30 million round and 'above $1 billion'.
notes: SOSV is an investor, so its piece is used as the founder's own account. The 2026 Molinos sale (Forbes Argentina, 10 June 2026) was subject to approvals; the story says 'agreed to sell'. Gita Chapter IV verses 33-34 (usual numbering).
